paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates Micro-F1 score results for two systems (MatDetector and ChemDataExtractor) across a set of λ settings. The x-axis is labeled “λ value” and is shown as an ordered set of discrete tick labels: “w/o”, then numeric values from 0.1 to 1 in 0.1 increments, followed by 2 and 3; the ticks are evenly spaced visually but represent categorical parameter settings rather than a continuously scaled axis. The y-axis is labeled “Micro-F1 Score (%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 52 to 58 with labeled ticks at 1-point intervals. MatDetector (ours) is drawn as a pink solid line with circular markers; it starts near 52.9 at “w/o”, is around 53.1 at 0.1, dips to about 52.6 at 0.2, rises to about 54.2 at 0.3, sits near 53.0–53.1 at 0.4–0.5, increases to about 54.0 at 0.6, is about 53.8 at 0.7, climbs to about 55.9 at 0.8 and 56.1 at 0.9, peaks near 57.9 at 1, then drops to about 53.7 at 2 and ends near 53.4 at 3. ChemDataExtractor is drawn as a dark blue dashed line with square markers; it begins near 52.9 at “w/o”, increases slightly to about 53.1 at 0.1 and about 53.3 at 0.2, drops to about 52.2 at 0.3, rises to about 53.4 at 0.4 and about 53.7 at 0.5, is about 53.5 at 0.6, increases to about 54.8 at 0.7 and about 54.9 at 0.8, decreases to about 53.9 at 0.9, rises again to about 55.2 at 1, then is about 54.5 at 2 and ends near 54.1 at 3.
